messages.content: Before I file this away, make sure the reservation actually lists both of us. Add Morgan Thompson as the second adult and record our road-trip arrival window.
I can update confirmation EPL-739284. What arrival time would you like recorded? The current drive estimate is 3:15-3:45 p.m., and the rate requires notice only if arrival will be after 6:00 p.m.
Put 3:30 to 4:00 p.m. We should still be fine after lunch, but I want a little margin for traffic onto the island.

Done. The reservation now lists Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson, two adults, with an expected arrival of 3:30-4:00 p.m. on Saturday, September 12. No late-arrival notation is needed, though the hotel asks that you call if delays push arrival beyond 6:00 p.m.
Now verify the whole charge, including parking, and give me the exact cancellation cutoff. I also want the Friday checkout stated clearly.

The complete six-night charge is $2,965.68, including the room, breakfast, taxes, and $150 total parking. A separate $300 incidental hold is placed at check-in and is refundable after departure if there are no additional charges. Free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. local hotel time on Friday, September 4; after that, the penalty is two nights.
Good. Give me one final drive-and-hotel itinerary with the confirmation number.

Saturday, September 12: leave Atlanta at 8:30 a.m., stop near Pooler around noon for lunch, and resume the drive about 12:45 p.m. Expected arrival at Elizabeth Pointe Lodge is 3:30-4:00 p.m.; call the hotel if traffic will delay you past 6:00 p.m.

Hotel: Elizabeth Pointe Lodge, confirmation EPL-739284, for Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson. High Floor King with Private Balcony and Partial Ocean View, six nights, checking out Friday, September 18. The confirmed total is $2,965.68 including breakfast, taxes, and $150 parking, with a separate refundable $300 incidental hold at check-in. Free cancellation is available through 6:00 p.m. local time Friday, September 4; afterward the penalty is two nights. The reservation and arrival note are complete.
